TC_BILL_001.description: Verify that the Super Admin can create a new organization.
TC_BILL_001.preconditions:
User on the Sign-In page.
riverstreamautomation@gmail.com must not be a RiverStream user: if it exists (e.g. the Riverstonetech user of the PO-ACK email suite), the Super Admin deletes it before the run (Settings > Users > the user > Delete) and adds it back to its organization with the same name and role after the run.
TC_BILL_001.steps:
1. Log in as Super Admin.
2. Click on Settings > Organizations.
3. Click on Add Organization.
4. Enter the Organization Name and Domain.
5. Keep the default Document Types.
6. Select the Free Trial plan.
7. Click on Create Organization.
TC_BILL_001.testData:
Super Admin: admin@riverstonetech.com / River@123
Organization: AutoRenewal_<run id>
Domain: autorenewal<run id>.com
Plan: Free Trial
TC_BILL_001.expectedResult: The organization should be created successfully and displayed in the Organizations list with Active status.

TC_BILL_002.description: Verify that the Super Admin can add an Admin user to the new organization.
TC_BILL_002.preconditions: Logged in as Super Admin; new organization created
TC_BILL_002.steps:
1. Search the new organization in Settings > Organizations.
2. Click on the View (eye) icon.
3. In the Users section, click on Add User.
4. Enter First Name, Last Name and Email.
5. Observe the Role (Admin).
6. Click on Create User.
TC_BILL_002.testData:
Organization: AutoRenewal_<run id>
Name: AutoRenewal Admin
Email: riverstreamautomation@gmail.com
(Gmail alias: delivered to riverstreamautomation@gmail.com, which is already a user of another organization)
Role: Admin
TC_BILL_002.expectedResult: The Role is Admin ("The first user of a Free Trial organization is always an Admin."). The user should be added successfully and listed in the organization's Users section with the role Admin.

TC_BILL_003.description: Verify that the new Admin user receives the set password email.
TC_BILL_003.preconditions: Admin user added to the new organization
TC_BILL_003.steps:
1. Open the Admin user's mailbox.
2. Open the River Stream email received for the new user.
TC_BILL_003.expectedResult: The email "Set up your RiverStream password" should be received ("Your RiverStream account has been created.") with a link to set the password.

TC_BILL_004.description: Verify that the Admin user can set the password from the email link.
TC_BILL_004.steps:
1. Click on the link in the email.
2. Enter Test@123 in the new password field.
3. Enter Test@123 in the confirm password field.
4. Click on the submit button.
TC_BILL_004.testData:
New password: Test@123
Confirm password: Test@123
TC_BILL_004.expectedResult: The password should be set successfully and the message "Password set successfully!" should be displayed.

TC_BILL_005.description: Verify that the Admin user can log in to the new organization.
TC_BILL_005.steps:
1. Open the application.
2. Enter the Admin email and password.
3. Click on Login.
TC_BILL_005.expectedResult: The Admin user should be logged in successfully and redirected to the Dashboard; the header shows "AutoRenewal Admin" and the sidebar shows "Free trial Plan".

TC_BILL_006.description: Verify that the Billing page opens from Settings.
TC_BILL_006.preconditions: Logged in as the new organization's Admin user
TC_BILL_006.steps:
1. Click on Settings.
2. Click on Billing.
TC_BILL_006.expectedResult: The Billing page should display the heading "Billing", the text "Manage your plan, payment methods, and billing history" and the Overview and Billing History tabs, with Overview selected.

TC_BILL_007.description: Verify the Subscription period options on the Billing page.
TC_BILL_007.preconditions: Logged in as the new organization's Admin user; Settings > Billing page open
TC_BILL_007.steps:
1. Observe the Subscription period field.
2. Select Monthly.
TC_BILL_007.expectedResult: The mandatory "Subscription period *" field should display the Monthly and "Yearly (save 9%)" options, and Monthly should be selected.

TC_BILL_008.description: Verify the plan details displayed for the Monthly subscription period.
TC_BILL_008.preconditions: Logged in as the new organization's Admin user; Settings > Billing page open
TC_BILL_008.steps:
1. Select Monthly.
2. Observe the plan cards.
TC_BILL_008.expectedResult:
The plans should display with a Get Started button and the "Save 9% with annual billing" label:
Starter - $249 / month - For small teams getting started - 3 Users, 150 Documents /month, 30 Days Document History Retention.
Growth - $449 / month - For growing teams - 5 Users, 400 Documents /month, 60 Days Document History Retention.
Pro - $649 / month - For enterprise-scale operations - 10 Users, 1,000 Documents /month, 90 Days Document History Retention.

TC_BILL_009.description: Verify that a plan can be selected.
TC_BILL_009.preconditions: Logged in as the new organization's Admin user; Settings > Billing page open
TC_BILL_009.steps:
1. Select Monthly.
2. Click on the Growth plan.
TC_BILL_009.expectedResult: The Growth plan card should be highlighted as selected.

TC_BILL_010.description: Verify that the Get Started button opens the Stripe payment form.
TC_BILL_010.preconditions: Logged in as the new organization's Admin user; Settings > Billing page open; Growth plan selected
TC_BILL_010.steps: 1. Click on Get Started in the Growth plan.
TC_BILL_010.expectedResult: The Payment Methods tab should open with "Subscribing to Growth (Monthly)", "$449.00 / month", the Stripe card form and the "Subscribe for $449.00" button.

TC_BILL_011.description: Verify the Card payment method on the Stripe payment page.
TC_BILL_011.preconditions: Stripe payment form open for the Growth (Monthly) plan
TC_BILL_011.expectedResult: The Card number, Expiration (MM/YY) and Security code fields should be displayed.

TC_BILL_012.description: Verify that the payment fails with a declined card.
TC_BILL_012.preconditions: Stripe payment form open; Card selected
TC_BILL_012.steps:
1. Enter 4000 0000 0000 0002 in the Card number field.
2. Enter 12/26 in the Expiry date.
3. Enter 123 in the Security code.
4. Click on the Subscribe for $449.00 button.
TC_BILL_012.expectedResult: The payment should fail with the message "Your card has been declined." and the subscription should not be activated.

TC_BILL_013.description: Verify that the plan is not active after the failed payment.
TC_BILL_013.preconditions: Payment failed with the declined card
TC_BILL_013.steps:
1. Navigate to Settings > Billing.
2. Observe the plan cards.
TC_BILL_013.expectedResult: No Current Subscription should be displayed, the Growth plan should still show "Get Started" (not Current Plan) and the sidebar should still show "Free trial Plan".

TC_BILL_014.preconditions: Payment failed with the declined card
TC_BILL_014.steps:
1. Open the Admin user's mailbox.
2. Open the email "RiverStream: Payment failed for your Growth plan".
TC_BILL_014.expectedResult: The email should display the heading "Payment Failed", the text "Your payment for <Organization>'s RiverStream Growth (Monthly) plan could not be processed, so the plan is not active yet.", Plan: Growth (Monthly), Amount due: USD 449.00, Card: Visa ending 0002, Reason: Your card was declined and the Pay Now button.

TC_BILL_015.description: Verify that the Pay Now button in the Payment Failed email redirects to the Stripe payment page.
TC_BILL_015.steps: 1. Click on the Pay Now button in the Payment Failed email.
TC_BILL_015.expectedResult: The Stripe invoice payment page should open with the amount $449.00, To: <Organization>, the invoice number and the Card payment option.

TC_BILL_016.description: Verify that the payment succeeds with a valid card.
TC_BILL_016.preconditions: Stripe invoice payment page opened from the Pay Now button
TC_BILL_016.steps:
1. Select the USD amount ($449.00) if a currency choice is shown.
2. Click on Card.
3. Enter 4242 4242 4242 4242 in the Card number field.
4. Enter 12/26 in the Expiry date.
5. Enter 123 in the Security code.
6. Click on the Pay button.
TC_BILL_016.expectedResult: The payment should succeed: Stripe shows "Invoice paid" with $449.00 and Visa •••• 4242, and the subscription status on the Billing page becomes Active.

TC_BILL_017.description: Verify the Billing Overview after the successful payment.
TC_BILL_017.preconditions: Logged in as the new organization's Admin user; Settings > Billing page open; payment successful
TC_BILL_017.steps:
1. Click on the Overview tab.
2. Observe the Current Subscription section.
TC_BILL_017.expectedResult: The Current Subscription should display Growth (Monthly) with the Active status and "Renews automatically on <payment date + 1 month>."

TC_BILL_018.description: Verify the "Your Growth plan is active" email.
TC_BILL_018.steps:
1. Open the Admin user's mailbox.
2. Open the email "RiverStream: Your Growth plan is active".
TC_BILL_018.expectedResult: The email should display the heading "Purchase Successful", the text "Thank you for subscribing. <Organization>'s RiverStream Growth (Monthly) plan is now active.", Plan: Growth (Monthly), Invoice number, Amount paid: USD 449.00, Paid on: <payment date>, Service period: <payment date> - <payment date + 1 month>, Next renewal: <payment date + 1 month>, Paid with: Visa ending in 4242, the attachment Invoice-<invoice number>.pdf and the View Billing button.

TC_BILL_019.description: Verify that the View Billing button in the email redirects to the application Billing page.
TC_BILL_019.preconditions: "Your Growth plan is active" email received
TC_BILL_019.steps: 1. Click on the View Billing button.
TC_BILL_019.expectedResult: The user should be redirected to the River Stream Billing page.

TC_BILL_020.description: Verify that the subscribed plan is badged as Current Plan.
TC_BILL_020.preconditions: Logged in as the new organization's Admin user; Settings > Billing page open; Growth plan subscribed
TC_BILL_020.steps:
1. Select Monthly.
2. Observe the Growth plan card.
TC_BILL_020.expectedResult: The Growth plan should display the "Current Plan" badge and a green dashed border, and its button should show "Current Plan" and be disabled.

TC_BILL_021.description: Verify that other plans cannot be selected while the subscription renews automatically.
TC_BILL_021.preconditions: Logged in as the new organization's Admin user; Settings > Billing page open; Growth plan subscribed
TC_BILL_021.steps:
1. Observe the Starter and Pro plan cards.
2. Observe the note below the Current Subscription.
TC_BILL_021.expectedResult: The Starter and Pro buttons should show "Contact Sales" and be disabled, and the note "Your plan renews automatically. To switch plans, cancel this subscription and choose a new plan once it ends." should be displayed.

TC_BILL_022.description: Verify that the Super Admin can see the current plan of the new organization.
TC_BILL_022.preconditions: Growth plan subscribed by the Admin user
TC_BILL_022.steps:
1. Log out.
2. Log in as Super Admin.
3. Navigate to Settings > Organizations.
4. Search the new organization.
5. Click on the View (eye) icon.
6. Click on Pay Now.
7. Observe the current plan badge.
TC_BILL_022.testData:
Super Admin: admin@riverstonetech.com / River@123
Organization: AutoRenewal_<run id>
TC_BILL_022.expectedResult: The Subscription Plan should be Growth (monthly) and the Pay Now plans should show the Growth plan with the Current Plan badge.

TC_BILL_023.steps:
1. Log out.
2. Log in as the Admin user.
3. Navigate to Settings > Billing.
4. Click on Billing History.
TC_BILL_023.expectedResult: The Billing History should display the columns Invoice, Paid on, Plan, Type, Service period, Card, Amount and Invoice PDF, and the row of the Growth (Monthly) payment: invoice number, paid on date, New subscription, service period, Visa •••• 4242, USD 449.00 and the Download button.

TC_BILL_024.description: Verify that the invoice can be downloaded.
TC_BILL_024.preconditions: Logged in as the new organization's Admin user; Billing History tab open
TC_BILL_024.steps: 1. Click on the Download button of the invoice.
TC_BILL_024.expectedResult: The invoice Invoice-<invoice number>.pdf should be downloaded successfully.

TC_BILL_025.description: Verify the details in the downloaded invoice.
TC_BILL_025.steps:
1. Open the downloaded invoice.
2. Observe the invoice details.
TC_BILL_025.expectedResult: The invoice should display the status PAID, Invoice No. (same as in the "Your Growth plan is active" email), Issue Date, Bill To: <Organization>, Plan: Growth (Monthly), Service Period, AMOUNT PAID $449.00, Payment Method: Visa •••• 4242 and Balance Due $0.00.

TC_BILL_026.description: Verify navigating back to the Overview tab.
TC_BILL_026.preconditions: Logged in as the new organization's Admin user; Billing History tab open
TC_BILL_026.expectedResult: The Overview tab should display the Current Subscription Growth (Monthly) and the Cancel Subscription button.

TC_BILL_027.preconditions: Logged in as the new organization's Admin user; Settings > Billing page open; Growth plan subscribed
TC_BILL_027.steps: 1. Click on the Cancel Subscription button.
TC_BILL_027.expectedResult: The confirmation "Cancel auto-renewal? Your plan stays active until the end of this period." should be displayed with the Yes, cancel and Keep subscription buttons.

TC_BILL_028.description: Verify that the Keep subscription button does not cancel the subscription renewal.
TC_BILL_028.steps: 1. Click on the Keep subscription button.
TC_BILL_028.expectedResult: The confirmation should close, the subscription renewal should not be cancelled: the status stays Active and "Renews automatically on <date>."

TC_BILL_029.description: Verify that the Yes, cancel button cancels the subscription renewal.
TC_BILL_029.preconditions: Logged in as the new organization's Admin user; Settings > Billing page open; Growth plan subscribed
TC_BILL_029.steps:
1. Click on the Cancel Subscription button.
2. Click on the Yes, cancel button.
TC_BILL_029.expectedResult: The subscription renewal should be cancelled: the status should show "Cancels On <renewal date>" and "Auto-renewal is off. Your plan stays active until <renewal date>.", and the email "RiverStream: Auto-renewal cancelled for your Growth plan" should be received.

TC_BILL_030.description: Verify that the plans are inactive during the cancellation period.
TC_BILL_030.preconditions: Logged in as the new organization's Admin user; Settings > Billing page open; subscription renewal cancelled
TC_BILL_030.expectedResult: The Growth plan should remain the Current Plan until the cancellation date, and the Starter and Pro buttons ("Contact Sales") should be disabled.

TC_BILL_031.description: Verify that the Super Admin cannot change the plan during the cancellation period.
TC_BILL_031.preconditions: Subscription renewal cancelled by the Admin user
TC_BILL_031.steps:
1. Log out.
2. Log in as Super Admin.
3. Navigate to Settings > Organizations.
4. Search the new organization and click on the View (eye) icon.
5. Click on Pay Now.
6. Click on Get Started in another plan (Starter).
TC_BILL_031.testData:
Super Admin: admin@riverstonetech.com / River@123
Organization: AutoRenewal_<run id>
TC_BILL_031.expectedResult: The message "This organization already has a subscription that renews automatically. Cancel it first to switch plans." should be displayed and the plan should not be changed.

TC_BILL_032.description: Verify that the subscription expiry email is received before the subscription expires.
TC_BILL_032.steps:
1. Wait until the expiry reminder is sent (before the "Cancels On" date).
2. Open the Admin user's mailbox.
3. Open the expiry email.
TC_BILL_032.expectedResult: The expiry email should be received by the Admin user before the subscription expires, with the plan name and the expiry date.

TC_BILL_033.description: Verify that the Super Admin can delete the Admin user of the new organization.
TC_BILL_033.preconditions: All the billing test cases executed
TC_BILL_033.steps:
1. Log out.
2. Log in as Super Admin.
3. Navigate to Settings > Organizations.
4. Search the new organization and click on the View (eye) icon.
5. In the Users section, click on the Delete icon of the Admin user.
6. Confirm the deletion in the popup.
TC_BILL_033.testData:
Super Admin: admin@riverstonetech.com / River@123
Organization: AutoRenewal_<run id>
User: riverstreamautomation@gmail.com
TC_BILL_033.expectedResult: The Admin user should be deleted successfully and removed from the organization's Users section.

TC_BILL_034.description: Verify that the Super Admin can delete the new organization.
TC_BILL_034.preconditions: Logged in as Super Admin; Admin user deleted
TC_BILL_034.steps:
1. Open the new organization's details page (View / eye icon).
2. Click on the Delete button.
3. Confirm the deletion in the popup.
4. Search the organization in Settings > Organizations.

After the run: riverstreamautomation@gmail.com is added back to the organization it belonged to before the run (same name and role), if the precondition of TC_BILL_001 deleted it.
TC_BILL_034.testData:
Super Admin: admin@riverstonetech.com / River@123
Organization: AutoRenewal_<run id>
TC_BILL_034.expectedResult: The organization should be deleted successfully and should not be displayed in the Organizations list.
